candidates.opening:
Opportunities are available for Site Engineers and Project Engineers to join a busy operations team delivering civil construction projects across regional NSW, ACT and SA.
Both positions operate on a 10:4 FIFO/DIDO roster.
 Key Responsibilities - Coordinate site activities and monitor construction progress against project schedules.

 - Interpret engineering drawings, specifications and construction requirements.
 - Track quantities, productivity and progress across allocated work packages.

 Additional Responsibilities for Project Engineers - Assist with cost control, forecasting, variations and commercial reporting
key_lines: - Work closely with Supervisors, Surveyors, operators and subcontractors to deliver planned works.

- Experience with quality assurance and technical documentation.
- Current White Card and Australian driver's licence.
Experience with self-performing civil contractors and renewable energy projects, including solar and wind farms, will be advantageous.

candidates.summary: Remote drafting role on major bridge, rail & infrastructure projects, with a clear path to lead our Australian design team.
candidates.opening:
ABOUT PERMADEC
Permadec supplies bespoke GRP (Glass Reinforced Polymer) permanent formwork for civil infrastructure - bridges, rail, wharfs and road overpasses. We are the Australian subsidiary of EMJ Plastics, which has been designing GRP formwork since 1964.
Recent and current projects include:
•      Inland Rail, Broadford to Albury (VIC) - GRP permanent formwork for rail infrastructure
•      Fremantle Bridge, Swan River Crossing (WA) - permanent formwork for the new river crossing
•      North East Link (VIC) - formwork supplied across various sections of Melbourne’s major motorway project
See more of our work at Permadec Projects and on LinkedIn.
THE ROLE
We are looking for an experienced drafter to take on design and drafting for our Australian and New Zealand projects. You will produce panel layouts and quantity take-offs, work closely with our experienced UK design team, and sup
key_lines: We are looking for an experienced drafter to take on design and drafting for our Australian and New Zealand projects. You will produce panel layouts and quantity take-offs, work closely with our experienced UK design team, and support sales, estimating and project delivery with accurate, buildable drawings. As the business grows, there is a clear path to step up and lead the Australian design function.
·        Solid drafting experience (typically 3+ years) in formwork and/or civil infrastructure - bridges, rail, marine or similar
·        Strong AutoCAD 2D skills
·        Experience with quantity take-offs
·        Relevant drafting qualification (e.g. Certificate IV or Diploma in engineering drafting) or equivalent experience
·        Allplan or other 3D modelling experience
·        Experience with precast or permanent formwork systems
·        Mentoring from an experienced international design team
·        Competitive salary plus super, matched to experience
HOW TO APPLY
Email your CV and a short cover note outlining your drafting experience to sales@permadec.com.au, with “Design Drafter application” in the subject line.
Permadec is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified people.

candidates.summary: Start your civil engineering career with Coolamon Shire Council, gaining hands-on experience whilst developing your skills!
candidates.opening:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Coolamon Shire Council is seeking a motivated Cadet Civil Engineer to join our Engineering and Technical Services team, commencing January 2027.
This role provides an opportunity to develop practical engineering knowledge and skills while undertaking tertiary studies in Civil Engineering. Council is open to supporting qualifications at Diploma, Associate Degree and/or Degree level, with the level of study to be discussed with the successful candidate.
You will gain hands on experience across a broad range of civil engineering functions, including surveying, design, construction, project management and the maintenance of Council’s infrastructure. As your skills and experience develop, your responsibilities will progress alongside your tertiary studies and on the job training.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Assist engineering design staff with the preparation of engineering designs.
key_lines: Coolamon Shire Council is seeking a motivated Cadet Civil Engineer to join our Engineering and Technical Services team, commencing January 2027.

This role provides an opportunity to develop practical engineering knowledge and skills while undertaking tertiary studies in Civil Engineering. Council is open to supporting qualifications at Diploma, Associate Degree and/or Degree level, with the level of study to be discussed with the successful candidate.

You will gain hands on experience across a broad range of civil engineering functions, including surveying, design, construction, project management and the maintenance of Council’s infrastructure. As your skills and experience develop, your responsibilities will progress alongside your tertiary studies and on the job training.
- Develop practical technical skills through on-the-job training and experience.
- Maintain satisfactory progress in Civil Engineering studies, working towards an engineering qualification.
- Current NSW Class C or Provisional Driver Licence (Essential).
- Current WHS Construction Induction Certificate (White Card) (Essential).
- Ability to complete tasks, reports and assignments within required timeframes.

Coolamon Shire Council provides a range of services and infrastructure to support the towns and rural communities within our Local Government Area. We are committed to developing our workforce, supporting learning opportunities and providing practical experience to help build future careers in local government.
A cadetship with Council offers the opportunity to combine tertiary study with valuable industry experience while contributing to projects that support our local area.

You will work on-site at our metro locations, collaborating closely with project management, contractors, and site teams to drive project success.
- Supporting the project team in meeting contractual obligations and regulatory requirements
- Tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline
- 3–5 years of post-graduation experience working as a Site Engineer on civil construction projects
- Experience with site management software and digital tools for documentation and reporting
- A valid driver's licence and willingness to travel between project sites as required
- Preferred: Experience with specific construction specialisations such as roads, bridges, drainage, or structural works

We offer competitive remuneration packages aligned with your experience and expertise, along with ongoing training and professional development opportunities to support your long-term career growth. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to a diverse range of challenging and high-profile civil construction projects across Victoria.

Negri Contractors is a well-established civil construction company with a strong reputation for delivering quality infrastructure projects throughout Victoria. With decades of industry experience, we specialise in complex civil works and have built lasting relationships through our commitment to safety, reliability, quality, and client satisfaction.
